_comment: The part catalog. Every part the game knows about lives here. mass is in kg. buoyancy is how many kg of weight the part can hold up when fully under water (more than its mass = it floats). An engine's power (watts) is shared by every wheel on the ground and every propeller: more engines = more power, but more weight. Its force is the most push it gives when you're standing still. A propeller's force is the most it can push by itself, its steer is how many degrees it swivels when you steer, air is how much of its push it keeps out of the water and water how much it keeps under water (1 = all of it, 0.3 = about a third, 0 = none). blade is how long its blades look, in metres. Add a new part by copying one and changing the numbers. shape (optional) makes a part thinner than a whole cell: a list of boxes, each with a size [x, y, z] in metres and an offset [x, y, z] from the middle of the cell (y -0.4 = sitting on the bottom, z +0.4 = at the back). The boxes are both what you see and what things bump into, and the part's weight is spread over them. Turning the part (R in the garage) turns the boxes too.
_tray_comment: A tray is a plate with a low rim on two sides (the back and the right). Turn four of them with R so the rims point outwards and they make a 2 x 2 box that holds a crate.
